meta.title: DshDataCat
meta.description: A database manager for MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Elasticsearch in the DSH sidebar. Browse databases, tables, and rows with column sorting, filters, stable pagination, and estimated or exact row counts. Stage typed cell edits with SQL preview and commit them in one transaction. Create/drop MySQL/PostgreSQL databases, export table DDL or DDL plus data, and run selected or full SQL in a syntax-highlighted playground with formatting. Use the page-scoped AI assistant with schema-only context by default; DSH agents can also call query, metadata, CSV/XLSX export, data dictionary, and schema diff tools. Connections stay on the Host; passwords are stored in the DSH credential store and non-secret source metadata in DSH_HOME/dshcat/datasources.json. Writes and high-risk statements require confirmation.
